name: @local/home-assistant
description: Control media players and streaming sources through Home Assistant from Hearth.

tools.name: get_media_states
tools.description: Get the current state, playback, volume, and available sources of media players connected to Home Assistant.

tools.name: control_media
tools.description: Send playback, volume, power, mute, or source-selection commands to a media player in Home Assistant.

entity_id.description: The Home Assistant entity ID, such as 'media_player.living_room'

command.description: The command to execute on the media player.

volume_level.description: Value between 0.0 and 1.0 (only used with command 'set_volume')

source.description: The source name to select (only used with command 'select_source')

tools.name: fetch_ha_endpoint
tools.description: Fetch a raw Home Assistant API endpoint to inspect or troubleshoot the integration.

endpoint.description: The API path to fetch, e.g. '/api/error_log' or '/api/config'

body.description: Optional JSON body for POST requests
